item.title: We moved our Bluesky data to Eurosky
item.description:
📝 Instead, our data now runs on Eurosky’s Personal Data Server (PDS). A Personal Data Server (PDS) is where your personal data is stored within the AT Protocol, the network protocol on which Bluesky is built. On traditional social media, you manage your account, but not your data.

Scammers Sell Seeds for Exotic AI-Generated Flowers That Don't Exist
item.description:
📝 Scammers are selling seeds for plants that don’t exist with spectacular, AI-generated images of technicolor leaves that bloom in the shape of birds, butterflies, and cat heads. At least dozens of sellers on eBay and Amazon also offer seeds for plants they promote with clearly AI-generated images. On Reddit and Facebook, plant enthusiasts warn each other about shady sites dedicated to selling seeds that offer the same fake plants.
🔗 Read more: https://www.404media.co/scammers-sell-seeds-for-exotic-ai-generated-flowers-that-dont-exist/
